result.summary: This residential street features sidewalks on both sides but lacks formal pedestrian crossing infrastructure at the visible junction. The wide, unmarked roadway and presence of parked vehicles create potential visibility and speed-related risks for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Lack of marked crossings
hazards.description: No painted crosswalks are visible at the junction where pedestrians may cross to access the park.

hazards.name: Wide unmarked roadway
hazards.description: The lack of lane markings on a wide street can encourage higher vehicle speeds and unpredictable positioning.

hazards.name: Sidewalk obstructions
hazards.description: Utility poles are located within the narrow sidewalk path, creating obstacles for those with mobility aids.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental-style marked crosswalks at the intersection to define pedestrian right-of-way.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Construct bulb-outs at the corners to reduce crossing distance and improve sightlines between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Speed Humps
interventions.description: Implement vertical traffic calming measures to reduce vehicle speeds in this residential and recreational zone.

result.summary: The image depicts a residential street with row houses and a continuous, wide concrete sidewalk. While the walkway is in good condition, there is no physical buffer or planting strip separating pedestrians from the roadway.

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Buffer
hazards.description: There is no physical separation or furniture zone between the sidewalk and the travel lane, increasing risk from vehicle encroachment.
hazards.location_in_image: Along the curb line in the foreground

hazards.name: Degraded Roadway Surface
hazards.description: The asphalt roadway shows significant cracking and uneven patching, which can affect vehicle handling and create trip hazards for crossing pedestrians.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Planting Strip
interventions.description: Install a green buffer between the sidewalk and the curb to provide physical and psychological separation from traffic.

interventions.title: Roadway Resurfacing
interventions.description: Repair and resurface the street to eliminate cracks and uneven patches.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: If this is near an intersection, curb extensions would shorten crossing distances and improve visibility.

result.summary: This is a typical residential street with continuous sidewalks on both sides, though they are narrow and obstructed by utility poles and trash. The roadway is relatively wide with parallel parking on both sides, but lacks marked pedestrian crossings or traffic calming measures.

hazards.name: Sidewalk Obstructions
hazards.description: Utility poles and trash bags are placed directly in the pedestrian walkway, narrowing the effective width and creating accessibility barriers.

hazards.name: Lack of Marked Crossings
hazards.description: There are no visible marked crosswalks at the intersection or mid-block, forcing pedestrians to cross without designated protection.

hazards.name: Visual Obstructions from Parking
hazards.description: Continuous parallel parking on both sides of the street can obscure pedestrians, especially children, from the view of oncoming drivers.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental-style marked crosswalks at intersections to clearly define pedestrian space.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Construct curb extensions at intersections to shorten crossing distances and improve visibility between pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces closest to the intersection to ensure clear sightlines for all road users.

result.summary: This is a residential street with row houses and narrow sidewalks. The pedestrian environment is basic, lacking formal crossing infrastructure and featuring several physical obstructions like a large tree stump and stairs encroaching on the walkway.

hazards.name: Sidewalk Obstruction
hazards.description: A large tree stump on the left and residential stairs on the right narrow the effective walking width of the sidewalks.
hazards.location_in_image: Left foreground and right side along the building frontage

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction
hazards.description: Continuous parallel parking on both sides of the street limits visibility between drivers and pedestrians who might attempt to cross.

hazards.name: Poor Pavement Condition
hazards.description: The roadway surface shows significant cracking and wear, which can be a hazard for pedestrians crossing mid-block.
hazards.location_in_image: Center and left foreground of the roadway

interventions.description: Remove the large tree stump and repair the surrounding walkway to provide a continuous, unobstructed pedestrian path.
